item.title: AI replaced 100 people, but somehow the company still needs humans 💀
item.description:
AI replaced 100 people, but somehow the company still needs humans 💀

@Amanda_Goodall

$NOW's CFO told Wall Street sales operations headcount is "down significantly."

McDermott said work done by "like 100 people in the sales operations department moving around information on e-mail" is now handled by AI.

ServiceNow's own careers site today: 5 open Sales Operations jobs.

Two were posted this morning, in Bangalore and Hyderabad. One went up yesterday in San Diego, where they filed a layoff notice this month for 25 jobs.

Blind says 40% is next. I can't verify that and frankly I don't buy that at all.

What I can verify is that the company that says AI took over sales ops is still posting sales ops jobs.
